$description: The site's two shadow recipes, stored as layers because that is Penpot's own shape for a shadow token — offsetX / offsetY / blur / spread / color, colors as 8-digit hex so the alpha travels (Penpot has no separate opacity field here, and CSS reads #RRGGBBAA natively). Both recipes are two-layer: a tight contact shadow plus a wide soft one, and both go deeper on dark, where the surface alone gives less separation. `panel` lifts the mega-menu panel; `popup` is the same recipe scaled down for the place-map popup — it was written by reading the panel's numbers, which is why they now share a source. tailwind.config.js composes these layers into the --box-shadow-* custom properties that main-nav.css and place-map.css read; build-penpot-tokens.js emits panel/popup into theme/light and the -dark pair into theme/dark under the same names, which is how every other theme-swapping token in this system works.
